As of my last update, OpenAI's latest flagship model is **GPT-4o** ("o" stands for "omni"). It was announced in May 2024 and represents a significant advancement in multimodal capabilities, offering improved performance across text, voice, and vision tasks. GPT-4o is designed to be faster, more efficient, and more accessible, with enhanced real-time interaction features.

For the most current information, I recommend checking OpenAI's official website or announcements, as developments in AI models can progress rapidly.
